title: Muse AI Invite Codes — Free, Community-Verified
excerpt: Find free Muse AI invite codes shared by the community. Check votes to see which codes work, copy one in a click, or share a spare invite.
content_html:
Once you have a Muse account, tap the Invite (gift) button in the top-right corner of the app to see your personal code. Every time someone redeems it, you get another 1 billion Muse tokens.

Share it here with the form above, so people who need a code can find it.
